question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

A blue-eyed boy
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The idiom **"A blue-eyed boy"** refers to someone who is a favorite or is highly regarded by someone, typically in authority. (पसंदीदा व्यक्ति)
 
 
• **Example:** Rahul is the blue-eyed boy of his teacher because he always excels in academics.
 
 
 
• In this context, the correct meaning of the idiom is "one who is favorite." (पसंदीदा व्यक्ति)
 
 
• **Example:** The manager always listens to his blue-eyed boy before making important decisions.
